close_reason: Work was completed in commit 92b46ac 'fix(jmap-metadata-server): MemoryBackend.query_objects applies filter and sort' (2026-05-15). MemoryBackend::query_objects now honors all five MetadataFilterCondition leaves (relatedType, relatedIds, filterMetadataType/@type, isPrivate, textMatch) per draft §3.4.1, and sorts by id+@type+relatedType+relatedId+isPrivate per §3.4.2 with a stable comparator. 14 integration tests in tests/metadata_tests.rs cover the filter and sort surface end-to-end and pass clean. Bead was stale; closing post-hoc.
description:
MemoryBackend::query_objects at memory.rs:484-532 currently has params _filter, _sort and returns the entire account's metadata sorted by id (already that). The filter MUST be honored at least for the spec-defined MetadataFilterCondition leaves: relatedType, relatedIds (when relatedType present), filterMetadataType (@type), isPrivate, textMatch (over string properties).

Walk the MetadataFilterCondition tree including FilterOperator AND/OR/NOT. Apply each leaf as documented in draft §3.4.1. Sort on at least id (MUST per §3.4.2) by default, plus @type/relatedType/relatedId/isPrivate as SHOULD.

Decomposed from JMAP-ayoz.6.
title: MemoryBackend.query_objects: honor MetadataFilterCondition + id sort
